title: ComboBox
description: Fiori combo box: free-text field with type-ahead filtering, inline autocomplete and the SAP keyboard model.

usage.summary: Choose one suggested value by typing, with filtering and optional free-text entry.
useWhen: Narrow a single-value choice by typing; choose the filter strategy for the supplied ComboBoxItem entries.
Accept a custom value as well as suggestions; handle committed text with onCommit.
Use onSelectionChange to distinguish a matched item from free text, which reports null.

avoidWhen.when: Require one short predefined choice and disallow free-text entry.
Create several free-form or caller-validated tokens.
Find a business value through several searchable attributes or enter conditions.
